Helps me sleep!. Love this app. I use airplane cabin and fan the most. Thank you for the Zzzz's.
Awesome app. We use this every night and it helps aid in a better nights sleep. I love that you can mix sounds, rain, thunder storm and ocean waves is the perfect combination! ❤️
Love!. Calming and soothing. My whole family loves it!

Great app!. I have been using this to provide some white noise for my baby to sleep to, as she sleeps soundly in restaurants and cars and outdoors but never at home. The sounds are very realistic and continue to play in the background when I use my phone for other things. Thank you for this great tool, makes my life a little easier!

Love it!. I use this as a sound machine for myself on my phone every night. Now my twins use it as well on my iPad. The airplane noise is my favorite. Never had a problem with the app in the 2 years I have been using it. Definitely recommend. Plus it's free!
Surprised. I never thought that there would be an app that had a fridge sound. I've loved the fridge sound since I was a toddler. Makes for a great night's sleep. Thanks.

Love!!!. I can NOT sleep in silence or without a fan blowing to block out sounds in the night. I recently went on a trip and the only thing I forgot was my fan. I was about to go spend $20+ at the store to buy me a new fan for 3 days when I discovered this app. I use it all the time - Even when I want to nap in the break-room at work. It's loud enough and it didn't drain my battery when I left it on all night!! The other sounds are nice and we've used them for relaxation/meditation exercises, but I'm a fan of the fan!
Great for fussy kids. Does what it advertises, but I use a limited feature set. As a white noise generator for cranky babies, it works great.
This baby helps me sleep. Great for traveling.
Great app!. This is my travel noise machine, the sandstorm replicates white noise. Perfect for my needs. Love it!
